notes.title: Back on Track – Little Astronaut Development Update 🚀
notes.content: [p]Hello Space Travelers![/p][p]I’m excited to share that I’m back working full-time on [i]Little Astronaut[/i]. The Steam page is being updated regularly with new info and fresh screenshots, so be sure to check in from time to time.[/p][p]The playable demo is planned for release this October. Until then, every bit of support matters: please add the game to your wishlist if you haven’t already, and share it with your friends. Every single wishlist truly helps the project’s future.[/p][p]Thank you all for your patience and encouragement—more news coming soon![/p]
